newsitem.title: CANADA: Canadian April budget deficit narrows.
newsitem.headline: Canadian April budget deficit narrows.

text.p: Canada's federal budget deficit fell C$652 million in April to C$3.407 billion from C$4.059 billion a year earlier, the Finance Department said on Wednesday.
April is the first month of the new fiscal year.
Most of the year-over-year decline in the deficit stemmed from higher revenues, which rose C$0.7 billion, the Finance Department said.
Program spending was marginally lower while public debt charges rose slightly, the department said in its monthly Fiscal Monitor.

The department said the increase in revenues came mainly from higher employment insurance premiums, personal income tax collections and corporate income tax collections. Excise taxes and duties and non-tax revenues were down year over year.
